findings.title: Hosted verification index retains two unavailable capture references
findings.description: raw_artifacts collection.json and execution.json retain paths and envelope hashes for deleted HG051-directory captures. Both paths are absent at reviewed SHA. Deduplication added separately named hosted.collection.json and hosted.execution.json entries with valid relocated captures, leaving the original artifact keys broken while all_artifact_hashes_match remains true. Raw evidence exists, but exact retrieval through the mandatory hosted evidence index fails.
findings.required_change: Add a corrected verification record explicitly superseding the faulty index, retaining only canonical artifact-name keys with existing run-specific relocated envelope paths and exact hashes. Validate every reference at the new evidence revision. Preserve faulty committed evidence and original run/raw bytes/tested SHA; update the own result to identify the new authoritative record. Commit this own-result/new-evidence repair before fresh SHA-bound reviews; it cannot use REVIEW_RECORD_ONLY.
